note: The client's own lookup of a map's row: its table of one 124-byte row for each map id (name, kind, region, world-map place), which is compiled into the client and cannot be edited (docs/port/24-custom-maps.md, 'The map's row in the client'). Kryta.dll replaces this one function so that a map whose record states a client_row is answered with it. The pattern is Py4GW Reforged Native's area_info_ref (offsets/map.json at 82e4746), given here with offset 0 so that it names the instruction and not the table address after it; Reforged reads the table's address from it and this document finds the function it is in. Measured in build 39167 (time stamp 0x6AE951C4): the instruction is at 0x5A6793, the function at 0x5A6770, it compares the map id with 0x382 (898 rows) and the table is at 0x96CF48.

row_lookup_ref.doc: imul eax, esi, 0x7c; pop esi; add eax, <table>: the end of the function that answers a map's row.

fetched_store_ref.doc: mov edi, [ebp+8]; mov esi, ecx; cmp edi, <rows>; jl +0x14; push <line>: the start of the function that records, for a map id, the content value its load ended with. Measured in build 39167 at 0x850E07; the function is at 0x850E00, compares with 0x382 and asserts 'mission < MISSIONS', MsCliMan.cpp line 368 (the owner's crash report of 2026-11-27, entering map 10000).

guide_place_ref.doc: push ebx; push edi; mov edi, [ebp+8]; cmp edi, <rows>; jl +0x14; push <line>; mov edx, <file>: inside the function that adds a map to the help guide's list of places entered. Measured in build 39167 at 0x4FC110; the function is at 0x4FC0F0 and asserts 'missionId < MISSIONS', GmHelpGuide.cpp line 2025 (the owner's crash report of 2026-11-28, loading into map 10000).

row_lookup.doc: const Row* __cdecl (u32 map_id): the function that holds that instruction. It asserts on a map id past the table's end.

fetched_store.doc: void __thiscall (u32 map_id, u32 value): the client's record of which content value each map was last loaded with, one slot for each of its own maps. Kryta.dll leaves a map id past the client's table out of it, because the record has no slot for one.

guide_place.doc: void __cdecl (u32 map_id, u32 kind): adds a map to the help guide's list of the last places entered. Kryta.dll leaves a map id past the client's table out of it.
